profile.description: 2026 festival runs Sept. 18-20 at Telluride Town Park. The event already operates a Rainbow Kids Area with inflatable bounce games, climbing wall, trampolines and other children's activities. Adventure Zone should not be pitched as a second inflatable provider beside the incumbent setup. Treat as a future replacement/backup-provider opportunity only.

notes.subject: 2026 review — existing inflatable kids area
notes.body: Official 2026 festival information confirms a Rainbow Kids Area with inflatable bounce games and other children's activities. Do not pitch Adventure Zone to operate beside the current inflatable setup. The Sept. 18-20 dates also overlap the current Pirate Fest placeholder, so 2026 should remain open only if the current Telluride kids-area arrangement changes and Pirate Fest is not using the same resources. Otherwise, revisit as a friendly future replacement/backup-provider opportunity. Keep any future wording non-competitive.
